host_scope: RTX 4060 Laptop GPU / sm_89 / WSL2 only

authority.owner_direction: Continue to the next stage and do not perform SHA verification.
authority.scope: Test only the selected eager CUDA BF16 lm_head mirror in the full C02 token population; no custom kernel is authorized.
authority.replication_disclosure: The owner waived repeat testing earlier in OP5. This is a single same-load lockstep deployment-equivalence replay, not cross-day or independent replication.

carrier.mirror_policy: Allocate one external, unregistered BF16 CUDA copy of the tied CPU lm_head weight. Never replace or move the original Parameter, token embedding, state_dict entry, or device map.

replay.equivalence_induction: Until A and B select the same token, their next input and common Transformer/cache trajectory are identical. The first unequal token conclusively fails deployment equivalence and triggers fail-fast; if all 21705 decisions match, the separate greedy trajectories are identical by induction.
replay.path_A: Current formal CPU tied BF16 lm_head, tanh(logits/30)*30, argmax.
replay.path_B: Selected external BF16 CUDA mirror with eager torch.nn.functional.linear, tanh(logits/30)*30, argmax.
replay.eos_policy: Record EOS positions but do not truncate; execute the frozen completion budget.
replay.kv_policy: Fresh cache per request; no cache crosses request boundaries.

measurement.paired_order: Alternate CPU-first and CUDA-first by global token index.
measurement.common_time: Wall time for CPU embeddings, transfers, and the common NF4 Transformer forward, bounded by CUDA synchronizations.
measurement.head_time: Wall time for each head path from the common hidden state through softcap and scalar argmax; CUDA .item synchronizes the selected token.
measurement.counterfactual_path_time: For each token, common_time + the corresponding measured head_time. The two path aggregates are paired counterfactuals, not two independent wall-clock replays.

correctness.hard_gate: CPU and CUDA softcap-preserving argmax token IDs must be identical at every one of the 21705 real decisions.
direct_fail: NaN or Inf in hidden state or either head output
head shape, dtype, or device drift
cache geometry, dtype, device, or logical-length drift
original tied CPU Parameter, state_dict, NF4 topology, module identity, or device-map drift
CUDA OOM or peak allocated memory at or above 7.5 GiB

replacement_checks: required input presence and model manifest byte sizes
same-hidden-state exact token comparison for every executed decision
direct Parameter/tied-storage, state_dict, NF4 topology, device-map, cache, memory, and telemetry checks

non_authorizations: board, llama.cpp, sm_100, or sm_120 extrapolation
moving or replacing the original tied CPU lm_head/embedding Parameter
